analysis:
MARKET REGIME — CONFIRMED DOWNTREND: SPY is -9.2% vs SMA50 with a negative slope. This single factor overrides most bullish setups. The strategy mandate is explicit: prefer cash or materially smaller size in broad downtrends. Quality stocks get dragged down with the market; this is where the strategy's deepest drawdowns historically occur. No new BUY is warranted today.

PORTFOLIO REVIEW:
1. AMP (-12.21%, $480.29 vs avg $547.12): This is the most urgent flag. At -12.21%, AMP is approaching the 15% drawdown tolerance ceiling (stop around $465). Financial services names are cyclically sensitive and historically underperform in market downtrends. The position is 9.7% of equity — manageable — but the trajectory in a down-trending market is worrying. If AMP closes below $470, the original thesis (mean-reversion in a quality financial) may be breaking. Treat $465 as a hard exit, no exceptions.
2. ULTA (29.5% of equity, $27,736 / $93,818): This slightly exceeds the 25% hard cap. The position is essentially flat (+0.29%), so there is no immediate thesis break, but the concentration is a rules violation. If ULTA weakens materially, there is limited room to maneuver. No action today, but trimming ~7 shares on any further strength would bring it back inside the 25% cap and free approximately $4,300.
3. ADSK (+1.30%), FOXA (-1.53%), UHS (+1.28%): All within normal noise. No thesis-break signals. Hold per plan.

NEW BUY CANDIDATES: Several high-quality names are on the list (APP has exceptional fundamentals — 55% revenue growth, 77% op margin, PEG 0.73 — and is basing at 24% of its 52w range; IR and NOC also show reasonable setups). However: (a) the market is in a confirmed broad downtrend, (b) 84% of equity is already deployed against a 95% gross cap with only ~$10,144 of headroom remaining, and (c) the Sortino Ratio of -16.31 signals poor current risk-adjusted performance. Adding exposure now would increase heat in a hostile regime with minimal margin of safety. Waiting for SPY to reclaim its SMA50 or for the headroom to increase (via AMP stop or ULTA trim) is the disciplined choice. Cash is a position. Forcing trades in a downtrend is the enemy.

STRATEGY: Hold cash, let existing stops do their work, monitor AMP closely, consider trimming ULTA on strength to get back inside the 25% cap. Revisit new buys when SPY stabilizes above SMA50 or when meaningful cash headroom re-opens.
